transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Um, thank you so much for seeing me. I really appreciate it. 

I guess I'm here because... well, I've just been having a little bit of trouble staying on task lately? It's probably not a huge deal, I know everyone gets distracted sometimes, right? But for me, the main thing is I just seem to get pulled off track by every little sound or thought. 

Like, I’ll be sitting there trying to work on a job application, and then... I don't know, a car drives by outside, or my phone lights up, or some random idea just pops into my head. And then suddenly I'm off doing something completely different before I even notice I stopped working on the application. I'm sorry, I hope I'm explaining that right... does that make sense for why I'd come in?
Have you had this kind of trouble staying on task since you were a child, or is this something that started more recently?

Um, yeah, I think it's... it's actually been going on for a long time. Since I was a kid, really. I hope it's okay to admit that. I don't want you to think I was a bad kid or anything! I always tried to be good. 

But, um... yeah, even back in elementary school, my teachers were always moving my seat around. I guess I was just a little too chatty and would talk out of turn sometimes? And I'd accidentally forget my homework a lot. Or, um, I'd just want to finish my worksheets so I'd rush through them and end up making these silly, careless mistakes. It wasn't on purpose, I promise, I just got a little ahead of myself. 

Does that... does that answer your question okay?
As an adult, do you often feel restless inside or have a hard time sitting still without fidgeting?

Um, well... I try not to be too bothersome with it, but... yeah, I guess I do get a little restless. I hope that doesn't sound bad! 

It's just, um... well, since I can’t really play soccer like I used to before, just sitting around the house all day makes me feel almost like I’m crawling out of my skin? Not in a crazy way, I promise! Just... like I have all this pent-up energy inside that needs to go somewhere. So I end up just kind of pacing from room to room a lot. Just to walk it off, you know? 

Is that... does that make sense? I hope that's a normal thing to do.
Do you find yourself struggling with constant, excessive worry about a lot of different everyday things that feels hard to control?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I hope I'm not giving the wrong impression, but I don't think I'm a super anxious person or anything. 

I mean, sure, I worry about things sometimes, like normal things, right? Like finding a job and stuff like that. But it's not... it's not constant or anything I can't handle. I definitely wouldn't call it excessive. I just try to take things as they come, mostly. 

Is that... is it okay if I don't have that? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
